title: Good idea, bad shape
body:
First of all there is not any trial period so I payed for one week to check the app. Black point number one.

When first open the app they offer (over and over) the lifetime subscription in 50% off. Aggressively marketing. Black point number two.

After paying so I wouldn’t have to see that ad every time they started to offer the PDFs files that not included in the price. Black point number three.

About the app from the inside, on first look it look really nice but when trying to start using it features doesn’t work good. On the “habit” section for example, I don’t get any notification even though I asked the app to remind me (and of course allow any permission they asked for). Nevertheless, the only notification I get from the app is about my progress and how many habits/challenges I have done today- but it’s always 0% even though I finished any task or habit for today. 

For conclusion, I’m about to remove that app right after the first week end.
author: yavbiton

title: Eager for your money !!!
body:
Once you open this app for the first time they want you to have a subscription and they don’t let you proceed without that.
Poor Poor Poor app !!!
